```json
 "rationale": "A 1.56 V swing needs a CS output stage, so this is a two-stage design. The budget is 37 uA: 10 uA reference, 6 uA tail and 18 uA output, about 61 uW. A small Cc (0.3 pF) gives a 28 MHz GBW at low tail current. The 18 uA output stage cannot put p2 above GBW, so Rz=(1+CL/Cc)/gm7 places the LHP zero onto p2. A short-L M7 keeps C1 small, which pushes p3=1/(Rz*C1) above about 100 MHz. Long-L loads give about 41+34 dB of gain."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (efficiency, low noise, big area)
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # input pair L
    "itail": (6e-6, 4e-6, 7e-6),     # first-stage tail current
    "gmid4": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L4":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror load L
    "gmid7": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # 2nd-stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.4, 0.25, 0.8),       # 2nd-stage PMOS L (short -> small C1)
    "i7":    (18e-6, 12e-6, 20e-6),  # 2nd-stage current
    "cc":    (0.3e-12, 0.2e-12, 0.6e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),        # Rz relative to pole-zero-cancellation value
    "Lb":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # NMOS bias-mirror L (tail, M8, reference diode)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    gmidb = 11.0
    it, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["i7"], p["cc"]

    # --- bias mirror (all same gm/Id and L) ---
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], it, vds=0.35)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], i7, vds=0.9)

    # --- first stage ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.55, vsb=0.35)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], it / 2, vds=0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], it / 2, vds=m4.vgs)

    # --- second stage ---
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)

    # --- compensation ---
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m4.cdd + m1.cgd
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 + CL / cc) / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # reference sink
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: diode side on vinn so out1 (M1 drain) gives correct polarity
    n.dev("M1", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "dio", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "dio", "dio", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "dio", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # Miller comp with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", cc)

    # --- predictions ---
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * CL + cc * (CL + C1)))
    zden = cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = m4.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m4.cgg + m1.cdd + m4.cdd))
    f = ugbw
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(f / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(f / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(f / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(f / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(f / (2 * pmir)))
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * m4.gm / mt.gds)
    psrr_db = db(A1 * A2) - 3.0
    swing = vdd - m8.vdsat - m7.vdsat
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (CL + cc))
    settle = 0.9 / slew + 5.0 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.6)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    nth = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m4.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = nth * 6.0          # flicker-dominated rough estimate
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "swing": swing,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
```
